key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:27DD0
name: remove_record_from_list
description: Scans a list of five-word records, ended by a negative marker, for the first record whose last word equals the value in D0. It then moves every following record back one slot over the match, leaving the negative terminator in place.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:27DF6
name: append_record_with_offsets
description: Appends a five-word record to a list ended by a negative marker, then writes a new terminator after it. Two words are the first two inputs minus the third input clamped at zero, two are the first two inputs plus the third, and the last is the fourth input.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:27DFC
name: append_record_with_two_offsets
description: Appends a five-word record to a list ended by a negative marker, then writes a new terminator after it. The words are the first input minus the third and the second minus the fifth, both clamped at zero, the first and second inputs plus the third and fifth, and the fourth input.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:27E3A
name: fill_offset_value_table
description: Writes the input 32-bit value and copies offset by 8000, 16000 and 24000 into a block as high and low word pairs. It then stores constant word pairs (256 with 7900, then 256 with 7956 in seven further pairs) and returns a pointer to a global buffer.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:27F66
name: run_timed_update_loop
description: Resets several memory variables and calls library entries through the jump table, then loops indefinitely. Each pass advances a 64-bit counter built from two 32-bit words, calls a routine when the counter reaches a stored threshold, makes extra calls when its low word is divisible by seven, and branches on bits of a flag byte.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:27FD0
name: copy_text_and_run_countdown
description: Copies a zero-terminated text from one fixed buffer to another, then runs a timed loop that subtracts elapsed time from 250000 on each pass until the value falls to minus 700000 or below, calling library entries each pass. Afterwards a loop polls an input byte and branches when it equals the character '1' (the listing is cut off there).

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28060
name: poll_keys_during_countdown
description: Runs a timed loop that polls an input byte masked against a stored flag and leaves on the characters '1' to '5' or once a counter passes its limit. On exit it resets several state variables and calls library entries.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2810E
name: run_timed_key_event_loop
description: Initialises several memory variables and flags, then loops indefinitely. Each pass advances a 64-bit counter, calls library entries, and leaves the loop on the characters '1' to '5' or once the counter passes a limit, after which it resets state and calls more entries.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:284B6
name: format_signed_decimal_text
description: Writes a signed 32-bit value into a text buffer as decimal characters, first writing a minus sign for negative values. It skips leading zero places by comparing against successive powers of ten and ends the text with a zero byte.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28536
name: convert_unsigned_to_decimal_digits
description: Converts an unsigned 32-bit value into exactly ten decimal digit characters, including leading zeros, by repeated subtraction of descending powers of ten. It writes a zero terminator after the last digit.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2861A
name: interpret_text_control_codes
description: Saves two byte arguments into a state block, then walks a byte stream from a fixed offset. Bytes of 32 and above are passed to a called routine while a column value is below a limit, codes below 32 end a line, load a pointer from a table, or skip the following one or two bytes, and a zero byte ends the walk.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28634
name: convert_long_to_hex_text
description: Converts a 32-bit value into eight characters, one per four-bit group from most significant to least, applying a second offset to groups above nine. It writes a zero terminator after the eighth character.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28656
name: read_line_with_backspace
description: Reads typed characters into a text buffer, starting after any text already present, until a carriage return. Letters, digits, space, underscore, hyphen and parentheses are stored while room remains, and backspace or delete removes the last stored character.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:286DC
name: read_line_appending_to_buffer
description: Reads typed characters into a text buffer until a carriage return, storing letters, digits, space, underscore, hyphen and parentheses while room remains. Backspace or delete erases the previous character, and the buffer is zero-terminated after each change.

name: parse_signed_decimal_text
description: Reads an optional leading minus sign and then decimal digit characters from a text pointer, accumulating them into a signed value. A minus sign causes the remaining text to be parsed and then negated.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28716
name: skip_decimal_digit_characters
description: Advances the text pointer past consecutive decimal digit characters and stops at the first byte that is not a digit.

description: Only calls one other routine and returns; no logic of its own is visible in the pseudo-code.

name: compute_cross_product_components
description: Stores three input values into a structure and computes the three components of a cross product from products of pairs of values, making one call to another routine. The first three products cancel in the listing, so the exact numeric output is uncertain.

description: Compares the low word of its input against descending thresholds and returns a bucket index from 2 to 9 with a paired constant for that bucket, such as 2555, 1297, 651, 326, 163, 82, 41 or 20. The highest matching threshold is checked first.

name: update_state_triplets_damped
description: Applies a limited-step update to three groups of three words in a structure, first adding scaled terms to one group when a register flag is nonzero. For each group whose leading value is negative, the step is shifted by a table value, the group's counter byte is reduced by a table value, and the counter is reset to 60 when it underflows.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:289A2
name: update_two_triplets_stack_limit
description: Applies the same limited-step update to two groups of three words in a structure, taking the limit from a value passed on the stack. Each group's counter byte is reduced by a table value and reset to 60 when it underflows.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:289A8
name: update_triplets_register_limit
description: Applies the same limited-step update to three groups of three words in a structure, taking the limit from a data register. Each group's counter byte is reduced by a table value and reset to 60 when it underflows.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28A72
name: update_two_triplets_stack_limit
description: Applies the same limited-step update to two groups of three words in a structure, taking the limit from a value passed on the stack. Each group's counter byte is reduced by a table value and reset to 60 when it underflows.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28B3E
name: update_triplet_selected_by_sign
description: Chooses one of two updates from the sign of a stored value and applies the limited-step update to a single group of three words, using a limit passed on the stack. The group's counter byte is reduced by a table value and reset to 60 when it underflows.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28B44
name: update_two_triplets_register_limit
description: Applies the limited-step update to two groups of three words in a structure, using a data register as the limit. Each group's counter byte is reduced by a table value and reset to 60 when it underflows.

name: update_triplet_selected_by_sign
description: Chooses one of two updates from the sign of a stored value and applies the limited-step update to a single group of three words, using a limit passed on the stack. The group's counter byte is reduced by a table value and reset to 60 when it underflows.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28DA6
name: shift_and_store_offsets
description: Reads two 16-bit values from fixed offsets in a structure, shifts one right by three bits and the other right by two bits with its sign negated, then stores both results at two other offsets.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28DBC
name: compute_dot_product_clamped
description: Stores a negated dot product and a second dot product of a stored vector against stored rows, and zeroes a middle component. When the third dot product is negative, it clamps the two stored results to positive or negative 16384 according to their signs.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28E38
name: compute_dot_products_inverted
description: Stores a dot product and a negated second dot product of a stored vector against stored rows, and zeroes a middle component. When the third dot product is non-negative, it replaces both stored results with their values shifted right by eight and XORed with 16383.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28EB0
name: compute_global_vector_dot
description: Computes a dot product between the first three components of a structure and a three-component vector in the global data area. The scaled result is negated and stored in a result slot of the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28EDA
name: update_triplet_from_partner
description: Compares type bytes of two structures and, for one combination with a set flag, halves a component of the first structure. Otherwise it stores a scaled dot product between the two structures' component triplets, with extra components written only when a register flag is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28EEC
name: compute_dot_or_halve_triplet
description: When a flag byte in the first structure is zero, computes scaled dot products between its component triplet and the second structure's rows, storing up to three results. Otherwise it stores halved components of the first structure, writing extra results only when a register flag is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28F18
name: compute_scaled_dot_triplets
description: Stores a negated, scaled dot product of one structure's component triplet against another structure's rows. When a register flag is nonzero it also stores two more scaled dot products.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28F92
name: scale_magnitudes_below_limit
description: Combines two 64-bit results from called routines after complementing any negative operands. It shifts both right by the number of bits needed to bring the combined magnitude below 16384, or runs a bit-by-bit shift loop when the combined value is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28FA2
name: scale_register_pair_below_limit
description: Applies the same magnitude-limited scaling to two values held in data registers, using the sign-corrected operands and their combined magnitude. It returns the pair shifted right by the count needed to bring the magnitude below 16384.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:28FF6
name: shift_pair_by_magnitude_count
description: Counts the right shifts needed to bring a data register's value to 16383 or less, then returns two input values shifted right by that count as one 64-bit pair.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2901A
name: stub_forward_two_calls
description: Only calls two other routines one after the other and returns; no other logic is visible.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2902E
name: compute_flagged_scaled_dot_pair
description: When the first structure's flag byte is set and the second's is clear, it combines the second structure's triplet with the input values, scales the sums with shifts and returns them as a pair. Otherwise it applies the same magnitude-limited shift scaling to two combined values.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:290AA
name: add_scaled_fields_to_pair
description: Obtains a 64-bit pair from a called routine and adds two 16-bit fields from a structure to its high and low halves. Each field is sign-extended and scaled by 1024 before the addition.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:290FA
name: subtract_fields_or_negate_pair
description: Returns two negated 32-bit fields from a structure. When a type byte matches a condition against another structure, it subtracts those fields from the halves of a 64-bit value returned by a called routine instead.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2911A
name: negate_pair_of_ints
description: Reads two 32-bit values at fixed offsets in a structure, negates each one and returns them together as a 64-bit pair.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:29128
name: return_pair_or_scaled_delta
description: Returns a stored 64-bit pair unless a state byte equals one. Otherwise, when a flag bit is clear, it calls a table entry with six 32-bit fields and returns the negated change in two of them shifted right by ten bits, and when the bit is set it returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:29140
name: return_scaled_delta_pair
description: When a flag bit is clear, calls a routine and then a table entry with six 32-bit fields, returning the negated change in two of them shifted right by ten bits. When the bit is set it returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:291B6
name: normalize_and_update_state_block
description: Shifts a 64-bit pair from a called routine until its combined magnitude fits a fixed range, then decrements a counter byte in the structure. When the counter underflows, it finds the largest magnitude among three stored values, recomputes scaled components and calls table entries; the listing is cut off partway through.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:291EC
name: update_state_block_from_registers
description: Normalizes operand values held in data registers by shifting them until their magnitude fits a fixed range, then runs the same counter-driven update as its neighbours. On counter underflow it recomputes scaled components and calls table entries.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:29298
name: update_state_block_from_stack
description: Uses arguments passed on the stack to update a state block: one path accumulates 64-bit totals from called results into the structure, clears related fields and returns zero, and the other recomputes scaled components shifted by a count from a table.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:29310
name: normalize_state_block_totals
description: Normalizes a 64-bit pair from a called routine by shifting it until its magnitude fits a fixed range, then recomputes three scaled components and decrements a counter byte. On underflow it adds three accumulated 32-bit totals into the structure and clears related fields.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:29346
name: normalize_state_with_counter
description: Shifts a 64-bit pair from a called routine into a fixed range and stores scaled components with their shift count, then decrements a counter byte. On underflow it accumulates totals into the structure and clears related fields.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:29400
name: compute_shifted_sum_triplet
description: Adds input values, each shifted right by a count from a data register, and stores three results at fixed offsets after shifting them left by a count clamped at twelve. It then returns a pair from a called routine shifted by a bounded amount.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2944C
name: shift_register_pair_right
description: Shifts two data-register values right by a variable count taken from a register and returns them together as one 64-bit pair.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:29458
name: stub_forward_single_call
description: Two instructions that make one call to another routine. The decompiler timed out, so no further logic is shown for this routine.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:29462
name: accumulate_state_or_shift_components
description: When any of three stored values is nonzero, it calls a routine, adds totals into the structure, clears related fields and returns zero. Otherwise it combines shifted input values with stored components, shifts them by a clamped count and returns a pair from a called routine shifted by a bounded amount.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:29490
name: accumulate_and_clear_state_fields
description: Copies a flag byte between two structures when a bit is set in the second, then adds a 32-bit value from a called routine into three accumulators of the first structure. It adds a 64-bit total into a second set of accumulators with carry and clears a block of related fields.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2950E
name: scale_registers_into_totals
description: Scales three signed inputs from data registers by a register-derived scalar, applying each product's sign. It stores three negated totals minus those products at fixed offsets, then returns a pair from a called routine shifted left by a count clamped at four.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:29572
name: scale_structure_values_difference
description: Scales three signed values held in a structure by a register-derived scalar, applying its sign. It stores each product minus the matching stored total at fixed offsets, then returns a pair from a called routine shifted left by a count clamped at four.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:29602
name: dot_with_normalized_inputs
description: Finds how many right shifts bring the three input values below 16384 in magnitude and shifts all three by that count. It then returns two dot products of the shifted inputs with two stored coefficient sets, each doubled and reduced to its high word.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2964A
name: multiply_inputs_by_matrix_rows
description: Multiplies three input values from data registers by two stored sets of three coefficients, doubling each sum and keeping its high word. The two results are returned as one 64-bit pair.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2969E
name: clamp_three_values_to_limits
description: Clamps three input values to limits stored in a structure: a positive value is capped by one limit and a negative value is raised to another. The three clamped results are stored at fixed offsets.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:296B0
name: floor_and_clamp_three_values
description: Raises the first input to a floor value passed in a data register and clamps the second and third inputs to limits stored in the structure. The three results are stored at fixed offsets.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:296BA

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2A9AA
name: initialize_entity_and_accumulate
description: Stores an input word and sets several state fields in a structure, then adds two values from function-pointer calls, shifted right, into three totals. It returns the result of a further call, or the input value on the other path.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2AA14
name: classify_and_update_counters
description: Calls a function pointer and classifies the returned value into ranges, adjusting several 16-bit counters at fixed global offsets when a state byte equals minus one. Other branches clear fields or adjust per-slot values, and the routine finishes by calling handlers and returning one.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2AA64
name: extract_flag_from_mask
description: Repeatedly calls a function pointer to produce a bit index until the mask bit at that index is set or the call's secondary result is zero. When a bit was found, it sets that bit in a second mask field and clears it from the first.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2AAB6
name: adjust_counters_by_input_range
description: Classifies a word input into ranges. The lower ranges add a table value, scaled by a stored byte, to three 16-bit counters, while higher values clear a slot. It then calls handlers conditionally and returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2AAF0
name: apply_table_value_to_counters
description: Reads a stored byte, clears it along with a 32-bit field, and when a state byte equals minus one adds a table value to three 16-bit counters. It then calls handlers conditionally and returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2AB24
name: apply_adjusted_table_value
description: When a stored byte is nonzero, sets it to one and adds a table value minus four to three 16-bit counters if a state byte equals minus one. It then calls handlers conditionally and returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2AB5A
name: consume_budget_table_entry
description: Subtracts table thresholds from the input until one goes negative, then decrements the matching slot count and increments a counter. A conditional handler call follows, and the routine returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2AB8E
name: compute_scaled_step_value
description: Moves a 16-bit field toward a target by a scaled step and clamps it. It computes a scaled magnitude from three vector components and a table entry, subtracts it from a 32-bit reserve, and returns it while reserve remains; when the reserve runs out it may first consume a global counter.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2AC78
name: drain_reserve_and_handle_empty
description: Subtracts an amount from a 32-bit reserve in the structure and returns while reserve remains. When the reserve empties it resets the reserve, adjusts a global counter or flag, calls a handler and clears two 32-bit fields.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2ACB2
name: refill_or_clear_reserve_fields
description: If a global counter is nonzero, decrements it, increments another counter and adds a fixed bump to the reserve. Otherwise it sets a flag, calls a handler when the flag was previously clear, and clears three 32-bit fields of the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2ACC2
name: decrement_charge_or_clear_fields
description: If a counter byte is nonzero, decrements it and adds a fixed bump to a 32-bit reserve. Otherwise it clears three 32-bit fields of the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2ACDA
name: set_flag_and_call_handler
description: Sets bit 0 of a global flag byte and calls a handler from a table when that bit was previously clear, then clears three 32-bit fields of the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2AD0C
name: tick_timer_and_dispatch
description: Subtracts an input amount from a 32-bit timer in a global block. When the timer wraps, it reloads it from a constant, decrements two counters, reads a value and may apply counter updates before calling a handler.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2AD14
name: reload_timer_and_dispatch
description: Reloads a 32-bit timer in a global block, decrements two counters, and conditionally applies counter updates before calling a handler.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2AD4C
name: release_slot_and_update_counters
description: When a slot byte is nonzero, clears it and zeroes a 32-bit reserve, adds a table value to three counters, and calls a handler.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2AD80
name: compare_and_release_slot
description: Compares a low byte returned by a called routine with a counter. When it exceeds the counter and a slot byte is nonzero, it clears the slot, zeroes a reserve, updates three counters and calls a handler.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:5:2AD86
name: conditional_release_slot
description: Calls a routine, then on one outcome compares its returned low byte with a counter and releases the slot as its neighbours do. A handler is called on every path.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0000
name: store_word_and_dispatch
description: Stores the input word in a state field. When the previous value was nonzero, it calls a function pointer chosen from a table by that previous value.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0014
name: store_input_word
description: Stores the input word in a state field and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:001A
name: lookup_scaled_table_value
description: Reduces a 32-bit input's range by shifting either its high or low halves into a fixed range, then returns a value fetched from a global table at a derived offset, shifted right by an amount that depends on the range.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0390
name: initialize_entity_table
description: Writes sentinel constants, a zero counter, and handler and buffer pointers into a structure. It then walks eight-byte table entries up to a fixed limit, copying each pointer and calling the routine stored in the next slot.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0464
name: initialize_and_iterate_table
description: Resets two sentinel fields when the input is below a threshold, clears several counters, then repeats passes until a counter reaches five, calling a function pointer for each table entry on every pass.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:04CC
name: run_periodic_entry_handlers
description: Clears three flag bits of a global byte and calls a handler for each table entry with a nonzero flag. When a 32-bit tick counter has advanced past a period, it calls a second handler for entries with bit 0 set, scaled by the periods elapsed, and then dispatches entries whose bit 1 is set.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0548
name: call_handler_if_active
description: Calls the handler stored in each table entry whose flag byte at a fixed offset is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:056A
name: fetch_code_when_flag_clear
description: Calls a routine when a flag bit is clear. The code that would then match table entries is unreachable in this listing, so the routine effectively only makes that call.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:05A2
name: call_handler_by_bit_index
description: Maps the input word to a bit index: 15 gives three, 16 gives four, 23 gives five, 18 gives six, and other values give one. It then calls each table entry's handler whose flag byte has that bit set.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:05EE
name: update_pseudo_random_state
description: Updates two 32-bit global state words by mixing them with a constant XOR, bit rotations and an addition, in the manner of a simple pseudo-random generator.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:060A
name: compute_scaled_random_value
description: Advances two 32-bit global state words with shifts and additions, then returns the low word of the first input multiplied by the high half of the new state, packed alongside the second input.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:062C
name: scale_input_by_state
description: Multiplies the low word of the first input by the high word of a sum formed from a data register and the state, then returns the product with its halves swapped.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:063C
name: negate_64_bit_value
description: Calls a routine for a 64-bit value and returns its two's complement negation, carrying between the high and low halves.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0648
name: multiply_difference_fixed_point
description: Subtracts one 64-bit pair from another and multiplies the difference by a 32-bit factor using 16-bit partial products. When the difference is negative, it negates the result of a called routine instead.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:064E
name: multiply_32x32_fixed_point
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values using 16-bit partial products and carries, returning a 64-bit result with additional status bits in the high word.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:06AE
name: compute_scaled_difference_vector
description: Stores two 16-bit differences between values returned by called routines, then multiplies scaled terms and shifts them by a count derived from a register. The results are stored as six 32-bit words of the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:072E
name: store_shifted_vector
description: Stores two input words and three register values into the structure, with the last three shifted left by one less than a count taken from a register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0738
name: accumulate_scaled_vector
description: Scales three 16-bit values from the structure by a factor derived from a register and shifts the products by a count from another field. It then adds them into three 64-bit accumulators with carry.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0796
name: normalize_and_double_result
description: Counts the right shifts needed to reduce a data register to zero, calls a routine for a 64-bit value, and shifts that value left by the same count.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:07BE
name: normalize_register_and_shift
description: Counts how many right shifts bring a data register down to 32767 or less, then calls a routine for a 64-bit value and shifts it left by that count.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:07D2
name: negate_64bit_result
description: Calls a routine and returns its 64-bit result negated.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:07E6
name: multiply_and_normalize_pair
description: When the high input is negative it negates a called result. Otherwise, for a zero high input and a small scaled value, it multiplies two 32-bit pairs with 16-bit partial products; for other inputs it shifts the high input down, calls a routine and shifts that result left by the count consumed.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:07EA
name: normalize_pair_on_flag
description: Like its neighbour, chooses between direct multiplication and a shift-and-call path by a flag condition rather than the sign of the high input.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:07EC
name: multiply_pair_unsigned_path
description: Shifts a data register right by seven bits. A large result is shifted further, passed through a called routine and shifted back left; a small result is multiplied as two 32-bit pairs with 16-bit partial products.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:07F6
name: multiply_and_round
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values by a 16-bit factor using partial products and carries, then shifts each result right by one bit.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0854
name: accumulate_pair_into_state
description: Adds the high and low halves of a 64-bit value from a called routine into the first three 32-bit words of a state block. Carries propagate into the next three words, which also receive two register values and two stored values.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0882
name: stub_forward_two_calls
description: Only calls two other routines one after the other and returns; no other logic is visible.

name: stub_forward_two_calls
description: Only calls two other routines one after the other and returns; no other logic is visible.

name: stub_forward_two_calls
description: Only calls two other routines one after the other and returns; no other logic is visible.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:08F4
name: fetch_table_entry
description: Returns the 16-bit word at an offset from a table base pointer held in a global variable, with the offset taken from the low word of a data register.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0906
name: store_table_pointers
description: Stores two address registers into two pointer slots of the global block.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0910
name: reset_table_pointers
description: Points two pointer slots of the global block at a shared global buffer.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0922
name: allocate_table_slot
description: If the byte at the given index is zero and a 16-bit counter is below a limit, stores the counter in that byte, records the index in a slot, and advances the counter by four.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:093C
name: append_indexed_record
description: While a 16-bit counter is below a limit, writes a low byte into a buffer at an index, records the index and counter in a slot, advances the counter by four and returns the pair. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:094E
name: write_byte_and_index
description: Stores a low byte at an offset in a buffer, writes a combined index word into an array, and advances a 16-bit pointer by four.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0962
name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:096E
name: check_bounds_and_call_pair
description: Checks two returned coordinate values against limits of 319 and 167. When the pair is out of range it calls a routine to fetch it again and returns if it is still out of range; otherwise it calls a routine.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0986
name: stub_forward_single_call
description: Two instructions that make one call to another routine. No further logic is visible in the pseudo-code.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0996
name: check_bounds_then_call_pairs
description: Checks two coordinate pairs against limits of 319 and 167, returning early when a pair is out of range, and calls a routine only when both pairs are within bounds.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:09AA
name: check_bounds_single_pair_call
description: Checks a returned coordinate pair against limits of 319 and 167, and calls a routine only when the pair is within bounds.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:09C2
name: set_flags_and_call_when_set
description: When a feature bit in the structure's state is set, sets two bits in a global status byte, stores 2 in a state field, sets one flag bit and clears another, then calls a function pointer. A second feature bit runs the same sequence with only one of the global bits set.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:09D4
name: set_flags_and_call
description: Sets two bits in a global status byte, stores 2 in a state field, sets bit 5 and clears bit 6 of a flag byte in the structure, then calls a function pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0A06
name: set_flag_and_call
description: Sets bit 2 of a global status byte, stores 2 in a state field, sets bit 5 and clears bit 6 of a flag byte in the structure, then calls a function pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0A32
name: handle_flagged_timer_event
description: When bit 10 of a flag word is set, clears it and adds four to a counter, the global one or a structure-local one depending on a state byte. It then sets a state value of seven, updates two flag bits, calls two function pointers and sets a global status bit.

key: frontier - elite ii v1.05 r4 (1993)(gametek)[cr flt]/Frontier - Elite II v1.05 r4 (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT].adf:Frontier:6:0A3E
name: set_flag_word_and_notify
description: Stores the second input as a flag word in the structure, adds four to a counter as its neighbour does, sets a state value of seven and updates flag bits. It then calls two function pointers and sets a global status bit.
